metadata.question: Does vegetation greenness (NDVI) in Toliara, Madagascar on average decrease during September 2021-2022 compared to the 2000-2015 average for the same period?

data.exec_msg:
Dataset used: MODIS/061/MOD13Q1
Baseline Sep 2000-2015 Images: 32
Target Sep 2021-2022 Images: 4
Total pixels (@1000 m): 764
Baseline valid px: 386 (50.5%)
Target valid px: 377 (49.3%)
Baseline NDVI mean: 0.298
Target NDVI mean: 0.234 (Δ=-0.064, -21.6%)
A: Yes
